title: Margins and ROCE: two firms
subject: Business
source: Written for business/y11 lesson 46 (Pupil PDF worksheet: own exam-style questions, case data and mark-scheme points (teacher-written))
intro: Lesson 46. Calculate, then judge which firm performed better. All businesses, people and figures in these cases are fictional, made up for practice.

questions.q: Calculate the gross profit margin of each firm.
Calculate the net profit margin of each firm.
Calculate the ROCE of each firm.

questions.a: Level-marked (9): B has the better NPM and ROCE (controls overheads, better return on capital) though A has the higher GPM and larger revenue; A's big gap from 40% to 10% suggests high overheads.

markScheme.a: Level 3 (7-9): a justified choice using the data, developed chains of reasoning, and a comparison showing why it beats the other option. Level 2 (4-6): reasons in context, little comparison. Level 1 (1-3): generic points.
